Who is
Konstantina Zivla

Konstantina Zivla is an INTERPOL lawyer representing individuals facing Red Notices, Diffusions, extradition requests, and cross-border criminal investigations worldwide.

Who is Konstantina

Konstantina Zivla is an INTERPOL Defence Lawyer and extradition lawyer representing clients worldwide in matters involving INTERPOL Red Notices, Diffusions, extradition proceedings, and cross-border criminal investigations.

She advises individuals seeking INTERPOL Red Notice removal, deletion requests before the Commission for the Control of Files (“CCF”), preventive requests, and strategic defence against international law enforcement measures Based in Cyprus and serving clients globally, Konstantina provides legal representation in complex international criminal matters where freedom of movement, reputation, and personal liberty are at stake.

Her practice focuses exclusively on INTERPOL-related defence, extradition law, and international criminal cooperation.

  • Called to the Bar Association (CY) in 2023
  • Associate at Athena Intelligence (Geneva, Switzerland)
  • Associate Member of Outline Chambers (London, UK)
  • Fellow in the Defence and Military Affairs Program of the Strategic Security Initiative  
  • European Criminal Bar Association.
  • Defence and Extradition Lawyers’ Forum
  • International Bar Association.

Client Testimonials

“Enough cannot be said about Konstantina’s true heart and attention to my family’s cross-border case. With such a sensitive and complex case that effects every area of my family’s life and the constant fear of the unknown, she has not only reassured us everything will be okay but she made us feel as if we have known her our whole life! The professionalism has been seen in every stage of this process,and she has made herself available anytime we needed her. As this case is being conducted from many time zones and multiple countries I am confident we have the best lawyer! I thank God our paths have met and even if my words fall short I am forever grateful for her service. Not just as a lawyer but as a friend!
Thank you.” Verified Google Review by Mr. J.D., USA.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • 1. What is an INTERPOL Red Notice?

    An INTERPOL Red Notice is an international request circulated through INTERPOL asking member countries to locate and provisionally arrest an individual pending extradition proceedings. Although a Red Notice is not an international arrest warrant, it may result in detention, travel restrictions, immigration difficulties, banking complications, and reputational damage.

  • 2. Can an INTERPOL Red Notice be removed?

    Yes. An INTERPOL Red Notice may be challenged and removed where it violates INTERPOL's Constitution, the Rules on the Processing of Data (RPD), or fundamental human rights principles. Requests for deletion are submitted to INTERPOL's Commission for the Control of Files ("CCF"), which reviews the legality of the data held within INTERPOL's systems

  • 3. How can a lawyer challenge an INTERPOL Red Notice?

    An INTERPOL lawyer may challenge a Red Notice by preparing a legal submission to the CCF demonstrating that the notice breaches INTERPOL's rules. This may include evidence of political motivation, lack of due process, human rights violations, disproportionality, abuse of process, or other grounds rendering the notice non-compliant with INTERPOL's legal framework.

  • 4. Why choose Konstantina Zivla for INTERPOL matters?

    When an individual becomes the subject of an INTERPOL Red Notice or faces extradition exposure, the consequences are rarely confined to a legal file. The outcome may affect where they can travel, where they can live, their professional opportunities, their financial affairs, and their family's future.

    Konstantina Zivla understands that these cases are not simply about legal procedures; they are about people whose lives may be significantly affected by decisions taken by international authorities. For that reason, she combines rigorous legal analysis with a client-focused approach that prioritises communication, strategic planning, and careful attention to each client's unique circumstances. 

    Her goal is not merely to challenge unlawful international measures, but to help clients regain certainty, protect their reputation, and move forward with confidence.

  • 5. I am based in the United States. Can I still consult Konstantina Zivla?

    Absolutely. INTERPOL cases frequently involve multiple jurisdictions, making specialised legal advice essential regardless of where a client is located.  Konstantina Zivla advises clients worldwide on INTERPOL Red Notice challenges and related extradition matters. Consultations can be conducted remotely, allowing individuals to obtain experienced legal guidance and develop a strategy before taking steps that could affect their legal position.

Confidential Consultation

Individuals seeking legal assistance with INTERPOL Red Notice deletion, Access Requests, preventive submissions, or extradition defence may submit an enquiry for a confidential case assessment to determine the appropriate legal strategy.

Book Now

Our clientele is international, and we are pleased to assist individuals worldwide with INTERPOL-related matters. Whether you are based in Europe, the Americas, Asia, or Africa, you are welcome to submit your enquiry and schedule a consultation.
